Read-only audit of the CROBOT admin panel at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT. I need to know what's actually working, what's mocked, and what's missing — before we plan a production-grade rebuild.

Report in under 600 words.

## 1. Admin pages — what exists, what's real, what's mocked

For each page under app/(app)/admin/, report:
- Brief purpose (from the code, not guesses)
- Real data flow (Supabase queries? service-role actions? edge functions?) vs mock/placeholder data
- CRUD operations: read-only? edit-capable? missing actions?
- Permission gating (who can access?)

Pages to audit:
- app/(app)/admin/page.tsx (dashboard)
- app/(app)/admin/users/page.tsx
- app/(app)/admin/users/[userId]/page.tsx
- app/(app)/admin/billing/page.tsx

- app/(app)/admin/flags/page.tsx
- app/(app)/admin/audit-log/page.tsx
- app/(app)/admin/integrations/page.tsx
- app/(app)/admin/support/page.tsx
- app/(app)/admin/system/page.tsx

## 2. Admin hooks + data layer

List files in hooks/admin/ and what each fetches (real vs mock).

## 3. Supabase schema — what admin-related tables exist

Inspect supabase/migrations/ — call out tables that are admin-only or admin-relevant:
- audit_logs
- feature_flags
- system_config
- support_requests / support_tickets
- profiles (role column, admin role values)
- Any admin-specific RLS policies

## 4. Admin permission model

- How is admin access enforced? middleware? layout check? RLS?
- Role values that exist (grep profiles.role usage)
- Is there a role hierarchy (super_admin vs admin vs support)?

## 5. What's clearly MISSING for production

Based on what's there, what admin capabilities are obviously absent?
Examples to consider (flag each as PRESENT / PARTIAL / MISSING):
- User search / filter / bulk actions
- User plan upgrade/downgrade by admin
- Refund / credit scans to a user
- Impersonate user
- View user's scans / usage history
- Ban / suspend user
- Cancel/extend subscription
- Manual invoice creation
- Feature flag target (user-level, plan-level)
- System config edit UI (vs env vars)
- Edge function health monitoring
- Error log viewer (Sentry integration?)
- Scan queue management (retry failed scans, cancel running)
- Broadcast message / email all users
- Support ticket assignment + resolution workflow
- Audit log filter / export
- Rate limit / throttle management
- Admin 2FA / session management

## 6. Sprint 1 recommendation

Based on gaps, what would a reasonable Sprint 1 focus on? Pick 3-5 items that are:
- Most impactful for production operations
- Feasible to build in a week (7 days)
- Don't require architectural rewrites
Give a one-line rationale each.

Do NOT modify any files.

## CROBOT Admin Panel Audit Report

### 1. Admin Pages & Real Data Flow

| Page | Purpose | Data Flow | CRUD | Permission |
|------|---------|-----------|------|-----------|
| **dashboard** | Platform KPIs (users, scans, revenue) | **REAL** — RQ + Supabase queries (count-heavy, no page visits) | Read-only | admin+ |
| **users** | User listing, search, filter, bulk actions | **REAL** — Supabase queries + RLS (admin sees all) | Read + bulk update | admin+ (super_admin for edits) |
| **users/[id]** | Single user detail, scan history, action buttons | **REAL** — Supabase queries + mutations | Edit (plan, role, ban, reset scans) | super_admin only |
| **billing** | MRR, plan distribution, revenue math | **REAL** — Supabase aggregates (profiles plan column) | Read-only | admin+ |
| **scans** | Platform-wide scan table, search, filter | **REAL** — Supabase queries + delete/retry mutations | Read + retry + delete | admin+ |
| **audit-log** | Chronological admin actions log | **REAL** — audit_logs table (write on every action) | Read-only (append-only writes) | admin+ |
| **flags** | Feature flag toggles (UI, feature, system) | **REAL** — system_config table (key-value JSON) | Edit (super_admin) | admin+ (view), super_admin (edit) |
| **system** | DB stats, environment health, config editors | **PARTIALLY REAL** — DB stats real; env health mocked ("unknown"); plan limits & pillar weights stored in system_config | Edit limits/weights | super_admin only |
| **integrations** | Integration status (Supabase, Dodo, AI, Email) | **MOCKED** — Env var check only; no real health probes | None | admin+ (view) |
| **support** | Support requests table, at-risk users, assignment | **REAL** — support_requests table (CRUD); at_risk_users is hardcoded mock | Read + update status/notes | admin+ |

**Key insight:** Most pages fetch directly from Supabase with browser-level RLS. No server-side admin API layer — all queries use anon key + RLS policies.

---

### 2. Admin Hooks & Data Layer

Located at `/hooks/admin/`:

| Hook | Fetches | Real | Notes |
|------|---------|------|-------|
| **use-admin-stats.ts** | profiles/scans counts, user growth, scan volume | REAL | Direct Supabase queries; caches 1min (stats), 5min (charts) |
| **use-admin-actions.ts** | plan change, role change, ban, reset scans (bulk & single) | REAL | Client-side mutations; writes audit_logs row per action |
| **use-admin-users.ts** | paginated user list, search, export CSV | REAL | Pagination, sorting, filtering all real |
| **use-admin-user-detail.ts** | user profile + scan history | REAL | Full profile + last 10 scans |
| **use-admin-billing.ts** | MRR, active subs, plan distribution, plan changes | REAL | Calculated from profiles.plan counts |
| **use-admin-scans.ts** | scan list, stats, delete, retry | REAL | Retry = update status to 'pending'; delete is hard delete |
| **use-admin-support.ts** | support_requests CRUD, at_risk_users | PARTIALLY | Support real; at-risk is mocked (hardcoded threshold check) |
| **use-admin-system.ts** | DB stats, plan limits, pillar weights, reset/clear actions | MIXED | Stats real; plan_limits & pillar_weights from system_config; reset/clear are RPCs |
| **use-feature-flags.ts** | system_config['features'] | REAL | Flag state read/write against system_config |
| **use-audit-log.ts** | audit_logs table | REAL | Read + filter by action |

**All use Supabase anon client + RLS.** No server actions, no auth middleware for data access.

---

### 3. Supabase Schema (Admin-Relevant Tables)

From migrations:

| Table | Admin-Only | RLS Policy | Notes |
|-------|-----------|-----------|-------|
| **profiles** | No | Mixed | Admin can SELECT all; super_admin can UPDATE all. Regular users see only own. |
| **audit_logs** | Yes | is_admin() | Only admins can read/write. One row per action (change_plan, change_role, reset_scan_count, ban_user, etc.). |
| **system_config** | Partial | is_admin() write, all read | Key-value store (features, plan_limits, pillar_weights). All authenticated users read flags; admin+ write. |
| **support_requests** | Partial | Mixed | Users create/read own; admin+ see all + can update status/notes/priority. |
| **scans** | No | Mixed | Admin can SELECT all; users see own. |
| **scan_results** | No | Admin read all | Supporting table for detailed results. |
| **integrations** | Partial | Admin read all | Integration creds (not admin-specific, but admin visibility). |

**Role hierarchy:** `user` → `admin` → `super_admin`. No custom role validation middleware.

---

### 4. Admin Permission Model

**Enforcement:**
1. **Layout check:** `/admin/layout.tsx` redirects if role ≠ `admin|super_admin`.
2. **RLS policies:** Supabase enforces per-table (e.g., admin_profiles_select_all).
3. **No middleware:** No auth checks on API routes; all data access goes through RLS.

**Role values (from profiles.role):**
- `user` — default
- `admin` — can view dashboards, manage users, toggle flags
- `super_admin` — can edit user plans/roles, ban, reset global counters, modify system config

**Gating examples:**
- Change plan/role: super_admin only (UI hidden for admin)
- Toggle flags: super_admin only
- View audit log: admin+
- Delete/retry scans: admin+

**No explicit 2FA, session management, or impersonation tokens.** Role stored in Supabase auth.users.raw_user_meta_data or profiles.role.

---

| Feature | Status | Why Missing |
|---------|--------|------------|
| User search / filter / bulk | PRESENT | Full implementation in users page |
| Plan upgrade/downgrade by admin | PRESENT | Single & bulk in users detail + users page |
| Refund / credit scans | MISSING | No credits system; only reset scan count |
| Impersonate user | MISSING | No login-as-user; would require session token minting |
| View user's usage history | PARTIAL | See scan list per user; no revenue/spending history |
| Ban / suspend user | PRESENT | is_banned toggle + logic in UI |
| Cancel/extend subscription | MISSING | No subscription table; plan is static |
| Manual invoice creation | MISSING | No invoices table; no manual billing workflow |
| Feature flag target (user-level) | PARTIAL | Flags are global only; no per-user toggles |
| System config edit UI | PRESENT | Plan limits & pillar weights editable |
| Edge function health monitoring | MISSING | No edge function status checks |
| Error log viewer (Sentry integration?) | MISSING | No error logging integration visible |
| Scan queue management | MISSING | No visible queue; can retry/delete failed scans only |
| Broadcast message / email all users | MISSING | No broadcast feature |
| Support ticket assignment + workflow | PARTIAL | Can set status/priority; no assignment or SLA tracking |
| Audit log filter / export | PRESENT | Filter by action; no export |
| Rate limit / throttle management | MISSING | No visible rate limit config |
| Admin 2FA / session management | MISSING | Relies on Supabase auth session; no admin-specific MFA |

---

### 6. Sprint 1 Recommendation (3–5 items, 7 days)
